decision.observation: The goose stands in front of the closed gate on the dirt path. The right post carries metal fittings: an upper bracket with a curved lever on the top rail (~0.64, 0.41) and a lower bracket with a hanging curved hook (~0.67, 0.62) that has sparkled when pecked before.
decision.hypothesis: The hanging hook may be a bell; pecking it (grab/press) rings it and summons the groundskeeper beyond the gate to come open it. First walk adjacent to the right post's base.
decision.memory: Plan: peck the hanging fitting, then chain several waits to allow an NPC to walk over.
